title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions (true positives plus false positives). Think about how changing the threshold might affect the number of false positives.

title: Understanding Recall
text: Recall is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of actual positives (true positives plus false negatives). Consider how increasing the threshold might impact the number of true positives.

title: Understanding Accuracy
text: Accuracy is the ratio of correctly predicted instances (both true positives and true negatives) to the total number of instances. Think about how changing the threshold might affect both true positives and true negatives.

title: Effect on Precision
text: If we increase the threshold, what happens to the number of false positives?

title: Effect on Recall
text: If we increase the threshold, what happens to the number of true positives?

title: Effect on Accuracy
text: If we increase the threshold, what happens to the number of true negatives?
